questions.question: A number when divided by 36 leaves remainder 25. What is the remainder when the same number is divided by 6?
questions.solution:
⇒ Let the number be x, then we have x = 36k + 25, where k = 0, 1, 2, 3,….

⇒ Now remainder when x is divided by 6, will be (36k + 25) / 6

⇒ Here, 36 is multiple of 6, therefore will leave 0 remainder. Whereas 25 when divided by 6 will leave remainder 1

∴ Overall remainder is 1

questions.question: If 2785P3 is divisible by 11, then what will be the digit in place of P?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2785P3 is divisible by 11.

**Concept:**

As per the divisibility rule of 11

The difference of the sum of the digits at odd places and sum of the digits at even places must be 0 or multiple of 11

**Calculation:**

⇒ (7 + 5 + 3) - (2 + 8 + p) = 0,11,22 

⇒ (15) - (10 + p) = 0 [since 11, 22… are not possible] 

⇒ 15 - 10 - p = 0 

∴ p = 5

questions.question: What is the value of 26 ⨯ 34 ?
How many zeroes are there in product 4⁶ ⨯ 15¹⁰?
questions.solution:
⇒ 4⁶ ⨯ 15¹⁰

⇒ (2²)⁶ ⨯ (5 ⨯ 3)¹⁰

⇒ 2¹² ⨯ 5¹⁰ ⨯ 3¹⁰

⇒ (2 ⨯ 5)¹⁰ ⨯ 2² ⨯ 3¹⁰

⇒ We know that wherever 2 is multiplied by 5 we get one zero,

⇒ And we cannot get any zero when 2 is multiplied by 3

∴ it is clear from the above that the number of zeroes will be 10

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 20 days. He worked for 5 days and B finished the remaining work in 42 days. B alone can do the whole work in how many days?
questions.solution:
⇒ A’s 1 day work = 1 / 20

⇒ A worked for 5 days

⇒ Then, A’ 5 days’ work = (1 / 20) ⨯ 5 = 1 / 4

⇒ Remaining work = 1 - 1 / 4 = 3 / 4

⇒ Now, B finished 3/4 of the work in 42 days

∴ Whole work done by B alone = 42 ⨯ 4 / 3 = 56 days

questions.question: Three taps A, B and C can fill thetank in 40, 48 and 60 hours respectively. How long (in hours) would the three taps take to fill the tank if all of them are opened together?
questions.solution:
⇒ Tap A can fill in 40 hours

⇒ Tap A’s 1 hour work = 1 / 40 ----1

⇒ Tap B can fill in 48 hours

⇒ Tap B’s 1 hour work = 1 / 48 ----2

⇒ Tap C can fill in 60 hours

⇒ Tap C’s 1 hour work = 1 / 60 ----3

⇒ Now Tap A, B and C’s 1 hours work = 1/40 + 1/48 + 1/60

⇒ Tap A, B and C’s 1 hours work = (6 + 5 + 4)/240

⇒ Tap A, B and C’s 1 hours’ work = 1/16

∴ A, B and C can fill the tank together in 16 hours

questions.question: If the ratio of edges of two cubes is 4 : 9, then what is the ratio of the volume of the two cubes?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of edges of two cubes is 4 : 9

**Formula used:**

Volume of cube = a³ where a → side of cube

**Calculation:**

Let the edges of two cubes be 4x and 9x

Volume of 1stcube = (4x) ³ = 64x³

Volume of 2ⁿdcube = (9x) ³ = 729x³

Ratio of volume of two cubes = Volume of 1st cube/Volume of 2ⁿdcube

⇒ 64x³ / 729x³

**∴ Ratio of volume of two cubes = 64 : 729**

questions.question: The marked price of a chair is Rs. 900 and a discount of 10% is given. What is the selling price (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
⇒ Marked price of chair = Rs. 900

⇒ Discount = 10% (given)

⇒ Discount = 10% of 900 = Rs. 90

⇒ Selling price = Marked Price - Discount

∴ Selling price = 900 - 90 = Rs. 810

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 550 and a customer pays Rs. 495 for it. What is the discount percentage?
questions.solution:
⇒ Marked price of article = Rs. 550

⇒ Selling price of article at which customer bought article = Rs. 495

⇒ Discount = Marked price - Selling price

⇒ Discount = 550 - 495 = Rs. 55

⇒ Discount % = (Discount / Marked price) × 100

⇒ Discount % = (55 / 550) × 100

∴ Discount % = 10

The mean of 20 numbers is 35. If four numbers 24, 20, 21 and 27 are removed, then what will be the mean of remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
⇒ Mean of 20 numbers = 35

⇒ Sum of 20 numbers = 20 × 35 = 700

⇒ Sum of numbers removed = (24 + 20 + 21 + 27) = 92

⇒ Sum of remaining 16 numbers = 700 - 92 = 608

⇒ New mean = New Sum /New Total Number

⇒ New mean = 608 / 16

∴ Mean of remaining numbers is 38

questions.question: If an article is sold at 5% profit instead of 8% loss, the man gains Rs. 260 more. What is the cost price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 The man gains Rs. 260 more.

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP -CP

**Calculation:**

Let Cost Price (C.P) of article be Rs. 100x

⇒ Selling Price (S.P) of article at 5% profit = 100x + 5% of 100x = 105x

⇒ S.P of article at 8% loss = 100x - 8% of 100x = 92x

⇒ Profit = Rs. 260

⇒ Profit = S.P at 5% profit - S.P at 8% loss

⇒ Profit = 105x - 92x = 13x

⇒ 13x = 260

⇒ x = 20

**∴ C.P of article = 100x = 100 × 20 = Rs. 2000**

questions.question: If the price of a commodity is decreased by 20% and its consumption is increased by 30%, then what will be the percentage increase or decrease in the expenditure of the commodity?
questions.solution:
⇒ Let the original price of commodity be x

⇒ let the original amount consumed be y

⇒ Original expenditure = xy

⇒ Price decreased by 20%

⇒ New Price = x - 20% of x

⇒ New Price = x - 0.20x = 0.80x

⇒ Consumption increased by 30%

⇒ New amount consumed = y + 30% of y

⇒ New amount consumed = y + 0.30y = 1.30y

⇒ New expenditure = 0.80x x 1.30y

⇒ New expenditure = 1.04xy

⇒ Percentage change = [(1.04xy - xy) / xy] x 100

⇒ Percentage change = 0.04x 100

∴ Percentage change = 4% increase

questions.question: If the price of a commodity is decreased by 30% and its consumption is increased by 30%, then what will be the percentage increase or decrease in the expenditure of the commodity?
questions.solution:
⇒ Let the original price of commodity be x

⇒ let the original amount consumed be y

⇒ Original expenditure = xy

⇒ Price decreased by 30%

⇒ New Price = x - 30% of x = x - 0.30x = 0.70x

⇒ Consumption increased by 30%

⇒ New amount consumed = y + 30% of y = y + 0.30y = 1.30y

⇒ New expenditure = 0.70x × 1.30y

⇒ New expenditure = 0.91xy

⇒ Percentage change = [(xy - 0.91xy) / xy] × 100

⇒ Percentage change = 0.09 × 100

∴ Percentage change = 9% decrease

questions.question: The speed of a boat along with the current and against the current is 16 km/hr and 12 km/hr respectively. What is the speed of the boat (in km/hr) in still water?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of boat in still water be u and speed of current be v

⇒ Speed of boat along the stream = u + v = 16 km/hr

⇒ Speed of boat against the stream = u - v = 12 km/hr

⇒ Speed of boat in still water = (1/2) × (u + v + u - v) = (1/2) × 28

∴ Speed of boat in still water = 14 km/hr

questions.question: A man travels 3 hours of the journey at a speed of 100 km/hr and remaining 2 hours of the journey at 120 km/hr. What is the average speed (in km/hr) of the entire journey?
questions.solution:
⇒ Distance travelled in 3 hours = 3 × 100 = 300 km

⇒ Distance travelled in remaining 2 hours = 2 × 120 = 240 km

⇒ Average speed = Total distance/total time taken

⇒ Average speed = (300 + 240)/5 = 540/5

∴ Average speed = 108 k/hr

questions.question: An amount invested in simple interest gives Rs 4200 interest at a rate of 15% in 4 years. What is the principal (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
⇒ Interest = Rs. 4200, Rate = 15% and T = 4 years, Let Principal be p

⇒ S.I = (P × R × T) / 100, where P is the principal, r is the rate of interest and t is the time period.

⇒ 4200 = (p × 15 × 4)/100

⇒ 4200 × 100 = 60p

⇒ p = (4200 × 100)/60

∴ Principal = Rs. 7000

questions.question: What is the percentage change in sales from year 2010 to 2014?
questions.solution:
⇒ Sale of company P in 2010 = 300 crore

⇒ Sale of company P in 2014 = 350 crore

⇒ Difference in sale from 2010 to 2014 = 350 - 300 = 50

⇒ Percentage Changes = (50 / 300) × 100

∴ Percentage Changes = 16.67%

questions.question: What is the average sale (in crores) from year 2009 to 2013?

⇒ Sale of company P in 2011 = 400 crore

⇒ Sale of company P in 2012 = 330 crore

⇒ Sale of company P in 2013 = 450 crore

⇒ Total sale of P from year 2009 to 2013 = 200 + 300 + 400 + 330 + 450 = 1680

⇒ Average sale from year 2009 to 2013 = 1680/5

∴ Average sale from year 2009 to 2013 = 336 crore
